description: Cron expression explainer and parser, next cron run times. Explain a cron expression in plain English (5 or 6 fields, e.g. '*/15 9-17 * * 1-5') and list its next run times in a time zone (default UTC). Says when the expression is invalid. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: cron_explain
